endpoints.description: Auth.js credentials sign-in (served by /api/auth/[...nextauth]). Called ONLY through signIn('credentials', { email, password, redirect: false }) from next-auth/react, which fetches the CSRF token itself. Runs authorizeCredentials: IP rate limit (10 / 5 min), user lookup, bcrypt or DUMMY_HASH compare, status and lock checks, lockout counter, audit. Used by the existing /login (verify only), C4 post-invite sign-in, and the C9 e2e signInAs helper.

csrfToken.note: from GET /api/auth/csrf; added automatically by signIn()

callbackUrl.note: sanitised by the redirect callback; the client also applies safeCallbackUrl()

responseSchema.note: Not the {data} envelope — Auth.js framework response. signIn(..., { redirect: false }) resolves to the object below.

success.sideEffects: sets the HttpOnly session cookie (8h JWT); failedLoginCount=0, lastLoginAt=now; audit auth.login.success

uiMapping.locked:<N>: This account is temporarily locked. Try again in N minutes.
uiMapping.disabled: This account is disabled. Contact the school office.
uiMapping.rate_limited: Too many attempts. Wait a few minutes and try again.

code.note: Mapped by the existing loginErrorMessage(code) in src/app/(auth)/login/LoginForm.tsx (already handles rate_limited, R3). Each failure audits auth.login.failure { email, reason }; the 5th consecutive failure also audits auth.lockout and returns locked:15.

endpoints.description: Auth.js CSRF token (served by /api/auth/[...nextauth]). Called implicitly by signIn()/signOut(). C9 signs in through the UI, so no test calls it directly.
Auth.js sign-out (served by /api/auth/[...nextauth]). Called only through signOut({ redirectTo: '/login' }) from the shell user menu (C7). Clears the session cookie.

Request a password reset link (C1 /forgot-password). Always returns the same 200 body whether or not the account exists (no enumeration). IP limit 10/h → 429; per-email limit 3/h is SILENT (still 200, no token). For an ACTIVE, non-archived user: createToken(PASSWORD_RESET, 60 min), sendAuthEmail('password-reset') → EmailOutbox, audit auth.password.reset_requested. UI (C1): 2xx → success Alert with data.message; 429 → error Alert 'Too many attempts. Wait a few minutes and try again.' (IP-scoped, so it reveals nothing about the account).

data.message: If an account exists for that email, we've sent a reset link.

error.message: Too many requests. Wait a few minutes and try again.

endpoints.description: Set a new password from a reset link (C2 page → C4 TokenPasswordForm mode=reset). verifyToken(PASSWORD_RESET) → policy → bcrypt 12 → transaction(consume token, set hash, passwordChangedAt=now, failedLoginCount=0, lockedUntil=null) → audit auth.password.reset. Success → router.replace('/login?reset=1'). 410 → C4 switches to the invalid-link Alert. Other sessions are revoked within 5 min through the passwordChangedAt recheck.

token.note: raw token from the URL; never logged or audited

confirm.note: must equal password. Field is `confirm`, NOT `confirmPassword` (system-design C4 wording is wrong). SetPasswordForm's onSubmit(password, confirm) already uses this name.

error.note: policy failures come back under fieldErrors.password (incl. 'This password is too common. Choose another.')

error.message: This link is invalid or has expired.

endpoints.description: Activate an invited account (C3 page → C4 TokenPasswordForm mode=invite). verifyToken(INVITE) → policy → bcrypt 12 → transaction(consume token, set hash, status=ACTIVE, passwordChangedAt=now) → audit auth.invite.accepted. Does NOT create a session: C4 then calls signIn('credentials', { email, password, redirect: false }) and router.replace('/dashboard'). On 410 C4 renders the FR-13 copy ('This invitation link is invalid or has expired. Ask the school office to send a new one.'), not the service message.

error.message: This link is invalid or has expired.

endpoints.description: Signed-in password change (C5 /account/security). requireUser → changePasswordSchema → bcrypt compare current → policy → update hash + passwordChangedAt → audit auth.password.changed → unstable_update({ reauth: true }) re-issues THIS session so only other sessions are revoked (within 5 min). Success → useToast 'Password updated', form reset, router.refresh().
endpoints.auth: session required (requireUser; middleware returns 401 UNAUTHENTICATED JSON without a session)

cases.wrongCurrent: { message: 'Current password is incorrect.', details: { fieldErrors: { currentPassword: ['Current password is incorrect.'] } } }
cases.policyFailure: details.fieldErrors.password (NOT newPassword): assertPasswordAllowed (src/server/auth/password-policy.ts) hard-codes the `password` key. ChangePasswordForm must remap password → newPassword before applyFieldErrors(), or the error renders nowhere. Client-side Zod already catches every rule except common-password, so in practice this case only appears for common passwords.

requirements.description: Prisma enums Role, UserStatus, AuthTokenType and models User, AuthToken, AuditLog exist with the fields in the PRD (status default INVITED, failedLoginCount default 0, nullable passwordHash until invite accepted, AuthToken.tokenHash unique, cascade delete). Status: already present; keep as-is.

A public /login page built from MUI sign-in template patterns (Card, TextField, Button, InputAdornment+IconButton show-password toggle, Alert for form errors). It has email and password fields and submits through Auth.js signIn('credentials'). Status: PRESENT (src/app/(auth)/login). Verify only; do not rebuild.

The credentials authorize function lower-cases and trims the email. It rejects when the user does not exist, status != ACTIVE, archivedAt is set, or lockedUntil > now, and it verifies the password with bcrypt cost 12. Status: present in src/server/auth/credentials.ts.

Every sign-in failure shows 'Email or password is incorrect.', with two exceptions: a locked account shows 'This account is temporarily locked. Try again in N minutes.' and a disabled account shows 'This account is disabled. Contact the school office.' The /login UI must surface the server's message.

A failed password increments failedLoginCount. At 5 failures, lockedUntil is set to now+15min and the count resets to 0. A successful sign-in resets failedLoginCount to 0 and sets lastLoginAt. Status: present (computeLockout).

Sign-in is rate-limited to 10 attempts per IP per 5 minutes using the in-memory sliding window exported from src/server/rate-limit.ts. Going over returns RATE_LIMITED, and the form shows 'Too many attempts. Wait a few minutes and try again.' Status: limiter present; the UI message is MISSING.
After sign-in, the user is redirected to callbackUrl only when it is a same-origin relative path; otherwise to /dashboard. Reuse safeCallbackUrl() from src/lib/validators/auth.ts.
Sign-in writes the audit entries auth.login.success, auth.login.failure (metadata: attempted email and reason) and auth.lockout.
The JWT session lasts 8 hours and is refreshed on activity. The JWT and session.user carry id, role, firstName, lastName and email. Status: present.

A session is invalid when passwordChangedAt is later than the token issue time. The jwt callback checks this at most once every 5 minutes per token, so other devices are signed out within 5 minutes. Status: present (RECHECK_MS).

middleware.ts redirects unauthenticated (app)-group page requests to /login?callbackUrl=<path>. Unauthenticated /api/* requests get 401 JSON with error.code UNAUTHENTICATED, except /api/health, /api/auth/* and the paths in src/config/public-routes.ts. Status: present in src/middleware.ts.

All AuthToken creation, lookup and consumption goes through src/server/auth/tokens.ts: createToken(userId, type, ttl) returns the raw token and stores its SHA-256 hash; verifyToken(raw, type) returns user/token or null when missing, used or expired; consumeToken(tokenId) sets usedAt. Status: present; no other module may re-implement hashing.

A public /invite/[token] page verifies the INVITE token (7-day expiry). An invalid, used or expired token shows 'This invitation link is invalid or has expired. Ask the school office to send a new one.' A valid token shows the user's name and email read-only, plus new-password and confirm fields. Status: MISSING (UI page). The API and service exist.

Accepting an invite validates the password policy, hashes the password, sets status=ACTIVE and passwordChangedAt=now, consumes the token, signs the user in, redirects to /dashboard, and audits auth.invite.accepted. Reusing the link afterwards shows the invalid-link message. Status: the service and API exist; the UI page is MISSING.

Password policy in src/lib/validators/auth.ts: 10–128 characters, at least one letter and one digit, not equal to the user's email, and not in the bundled 1,000-entry src/server/auth/common-passwords.txt. 'password123' fails the common-password rule. Status: present.

A live strength checklist under every new-password field (invite, reset, change) shows each policy rule as met or unmet, driven by passwordChecks()/PASSWORD_RULES. Status: the PasswordChecklist component exists. It must be wired into the invite, reset and security pages.

A public /forgot-password page has an email field. It always shows "If an account exists for that email, we've sent a reset link." (no user enumeration) and is rate-limited to 3 requests per email per hour and 10 per IP per hour. Status: the API exists; the /forgot-password UI page is MISSING.

When the email belongs to an ACTIVE user, the service creates a PASSWORD_RESET token via createToken(userId, 'PASSWORD_RESET', { minutes: 60 }) (32 random bytes, base64url), invalidates older unused reset tokens, and calls sendAuthEmail(user, 'password-reset', link). An unknown email creates no token row.

A public /reset-password/[token] page has new-password and confirm fields. On success the service sets the hash and passwordChangedAt=now, clears the lockout fields, consumes the token, and audits auth.password.reset. The UI then redirects to /login, which shows a useToast success toast. Status: the API exists; the /reset-password/[token] UI page is MISSING.

An /account/security page (any signed-in user) has current, new and confirm password fields and calls POST /api/account/password. A wrong current password shows the field error 'Current password is incorrect.' Success shows the toast 'Password updated', invalidates other sessions through passwordChangedAt, and re-issues the current session. Status: the API exists; the /account/security UI page is MISSING.
Add an 'Account security' item, linking to /account/security, to the top-bar user menu. Status: MISSING.

src/server/services/users.ts provides createUser (INVITED, throws CONFLICT on duplicate email), createInviteToken (7-day INVITE token via tokens.ts, invalidates older unused invites), sendInvite (createInviteToken + sendAuthEmail 'invite'), setUserStatus and unlockUser. Status: present; verify only.

src/server/auth/requireRole.ts exposes getCurrentUser() (session user or null), requireUser() (throws AppError UNAUTHENTICATED; pages redirect to /login) and requireRole(...roles) (throws FORBIDDEN, so a STUDENT calling an ADMIN handler gets 403; pages redirect to /forbidden). There is no separate permissions.ts and no can() helper. Status: present.

src/server/audit.ts audit({ actorId, action, entityType?, entityId?, metadata?, request? }) inserts an AuditLog row, captures the IP from x-forwarded-for when a request is passed, and never throws (errors go to the logger). Status: present.

Delete PLACEHOLDER_USER from src/app/(app)/shell.tsx. The shell gets the real signed-in user from the session, so the codebase has exactly one source of 'current user'. Status: MISSING (PLACEHOLDER_USER is still in shell.tsx).
The top-bar user menu shows the real user's name, a role badge and avatar initials. 'Sign out' calls signOut() and redirects to /login. Status: MISSING.
Sidebar navigation filtering (navigationForRole in src/config/navigation.ts) uses the session role instead of the placeholder role. Status: MISSING (navigationForRole(PLACEHOLDER_USER.role)).

The seed idempotently creates six ACTIVE users with password 'SchoolHub123!': admin@ Alice Admin ADMIN, teacher@ Tom Teacher TEACHER, teacher2@ Tina Tutor TEACHER, student@ Sam Student STUDENT, student2@ Sara Scholar STUDENT, parent@ Pat Parent PARENT (all @schoolhub.test). The existing seed has no users. Status: PRESENT (prisma/seed.ts).
The seed creates one INVITED user, invited@schoolhub.test, and logs its invite link during seeding. Status: PRESENT (prisma/seed.ts).
The seed logs the invite link through logger (createInviteToken + authLink) rather than through sendAuthEmail, because PRD-04's sendAuthEmail enqueues email and deliberately never logs raw links.
